reason: Run 38214103321 (candidate 0.0.6-beta.1 / fcadbc13, glm-5.3 at reasoning effort high, 30-task frozen corpus) scored 18 passed / 12 failed, passAt1 0.60. Seven of the twelve failures are not clean capability evidence: four carry an explicit upstream provider transport failure in their own evidence, two were stopped inside the candidate's own attempt-budget window with no model failure at all, and one ended in the delivery step with a build-failed delivery. This batch re-measures exactly those seven, one predeclared attempt each, under the identical composition, so that 'the cell does not pass' can be separated from 'the cell was cut off, or hit a transient upstream transport failure, before it could'. readingBoundary: What this batch can and cannot say. It CAN say, per cell, whether a fresh single attempt under the same composition reaches a model-completed or delivery-completed state and what verdict it then earns; a cell that passes here shows its reward 0 in run 38214103321 was produced by the transport failure, the budget-window cut-off or the delivery build failure, not by a capability limit at that moment. It CANNOT lower or raise run 38214103321's pass rate: that run's frozen record keeps 18 passed / 12 failed / passAt1 0.60 whatever this batch returns, and no number here may be merged with it or with any other run. A cell that fails again is not proof of a capability limit either, because one extra attempt is still one attempt; and because the seven cells were selected precisely for having been cut off, any pass-rate computed over them is a selected-subset figure and is never comparable to the corpus pass rate. Run-to-run variance is material on this corpus (10 of 30 cells flipped between run 37610731220 and run 38214103321), so a flip here is weak evidence about the candidate.
plannedChecks: After the batch finishes: read its own report against the seven predeclared cells (present, disposition, durationMs, usage, evidenceSha256); for each cell compare its new terminalCause, model-failure entries and verifier outcome with the cell's own record in run 38214103321; then write the batch's outcome into this manifest (outcome.cells with disposition, rewards, durationMs and class, so scripts/frontier-harness-repaired-reading.mjs can publish a companion reading) and record the batch in docs/benchmarks/history/frontier-harness/ beside the run it re-measures. outcome.reading: Of the seven cells re-measured once each under the identical composition, 2 flipped to passed and 5 stayed failed. The two flips isolate the two artefacts: anko's reward 0 in run 38214103321 came from the delivery step (its delivery failed to compile there and built cleanly here, f2p 9/9), and build-cython-ext's came from the provider transport failure (it completed and passed here). Four cells met a fresh transport failure and are therefore still not separable on capability; the fifth (polyglot-c-py) finally produced a completed attempt with a mechanical verifier verdict of 0, which upgrades that cell from 'inconclusive' to genuine (if single-attempt) capability evidence. Run 38214103321 itself is unchanged: 18 passed / 12 failed / passAt1 0.60 remains its own reading, and nothing here is merged into it.
